# jira-aipcc-create

Create AIPCC-org Jira issues in the RHAI project. Infers summary, description, type, and component from conversation context, confirms with the user before creating. Use when the user wants to file a new AIPCC Jira issue.

**Plugin**: [odh-jira](index.md) | **:material-check: User-invocable**

## Usage

```bash
/jira-aipcc-create
```
